source_audit_notes.observation: The exact upstream primary entry is a re-export barrel and Rollup emits zero runtime bytes for it. The graph reaches its imported context, content, list and trigger implementations, which emit real code and are browser exercised. The unmodified checker rejects the zero-byte barrel; retain this mechanical limitation rather than fabricating runtime work.

The imported two-column 4/6 login composition is preserved. The user explicitly requires no decorative design, so its sample Next.js sky image is replaced by product context and the real auth form. The tiny upstream page falls below the checker text similarity threshold after the required framework and no-art adaptation. No imitation illustration is installed.
